info.title: updown Trade API
info.description: Public REST API. Market data needs no key; `/account` (and order entry, when it ships) takes an API key. Prices are dollar strings on the 1¢ grid, counts are contract strings, times are epoch ms. Generated from packages/protocol — do not edit by hand.

get.description: Whether the API is up and reading the book, and whether any market is open for trading.

503.description: The book could not be read (code EXCHANGE_UNAVAILABLE); retry.

get.description: Every recurring market — a series opens a new window on a fixed schedule (`sol-15m`: every 15 minutes) — with its settlement rule, price grid and fees.

503.description: The book could not be read (code EXCHANGE_UNAVAILABLE); retry.
The book could not be read (code EXCHANGE_UNAVAILABLE); retry.

get.description: Markets (windows) on the order book, newest first, filtered by series and status. A window stays listed until about an hour after it settles.

503.description: The book could not be read (code EXCHANGE_UNAVAILABLE); retry.

get.description: One window: its status, times, price to beat, top of book and, once settled, the result.

503.description: The book could not be read (code EXCHANGE_UNAVAILABLE); retry.

get.description: The book as bids only, per outcome, best price first. An offer to sell Up at p is the same liquidity as a bid for Down at 1 − p, so it is listed once, under `down`. `checksum` covers the full book's top 10 levels per side — the same number the websocket sends.

503.description: The book could not be read (code EXCHANGE_UNAVAILABLE); retry.

get.description: Public trades of a market, newest first, described from the taker's side. Pass `cursor` back for the next (older) page. Accounts are never published.

503.description: The book could not be read (code EXCHANGE_UNAVAILABLE); retry.

get.description: The API key this request was made with, as the server sees it: name, environment, permissions and limits. Never returns the secret. Call it to check a key works.

401.description: No key, or one that isn't valid — revoked, expired, wrong environment or IP (code UNAUTHORIZED).

503.description: The book could not be read (code EXCHANGE_UNAVAILABLE); retry.

post.description: Place a limit order (`trade` key). `client_order_id` is required and idempotent: resending the same id with the same body returns the order already placed, never a second one. After a timeout or `503 EXCHANGE_UNAVAILABLE`, retry with the SAME id.

201.description: The order, as the book holds it after this call.

401.description: No API key, or one that isn't valid (code UNAUTHORIZED).

403.description: The key lacks the permission, or the account can't trade yet (code FORBIDDEN).

409.description: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT (that id was used for a different order) or ACCOUNT_BUSY (retry in a moment).
